name: SolarEdge-Modbus
description: Local Modbus TCP integration for SolarEdge HD-Wave inverters
author: Wolffie

collector.description: Collects real-time power data every 20 seconds via Modbus TCP

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: Solar curtailment now actually works. It never did before — the old version wrote to the wrong registers, the inverter rejected every attempt, and nothing was logged. Curtailment has been silently broken since v1.2.0.
Curtailment is now set in watts instead of a percentage, so you can compare it against what the house is using. Default is 400 W.
Never caps to zero. Below roughly 30-60 W the inverter disconnects from the grid and needs several minutes to come back, so a small amount of production is always left running.
Added a Curtail Solar card to the Manual Dispatch screen, with a Stop button that appears while curtailment is active.
If Wolffie stops responding while solar is curtailed, the inverter now restores full production by itself within about six minutes.
Every limit is read back from the inverter to confirm it was accepted. Failures are logged loudly instead of passing quietly.

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: Fixed: a hung Modbus TCP connection (inverter accepts the handshake but never replies) could silently stall this module forever — no error, no log line, until the whole server was restarted
Root cause: CollectorManager only arms the next poll cycle after collect() resolves, so a connectTCP()/readHoldingRegisters() call that never settles permanently freezes this module's schedule

Added abort() to api.js, collector.js, and index.js — implements CollectorManager's new optional hang-recovery contract: force-closes the stuck connection (graceful close() first, falling back to a direct socket destroy) when a cycle is judged hung
Requires collectorManager.js >=1.x with the hang-timeout guard (default 8s deadline per cycle, MAX_CONSECUTIVE_ERRORS raised to 15, failures logged via eventLogService as 'collect_paused')

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: Fixed _int16() incorrectly applying uint16 sentinel guard (0xFFF0) to signed int16 scale factor registers
Valid firmware SF values -1 (0xFFFF) and -2 (0xFFFE) were silently discarded, forcing hardcoded fallback
SunSpec-correct not-implemented sentinel for int16 is only 0x8000 — guard removed accordingly
Solar power now reads correctly at all production levels including low-light conditions

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: Switched to fresh-connection-per-cycle strategy — connect() → fetchAll() → disconnect() every poll
SE3000H silently drops persistent TCP connections after ~30-60s causing sentinel value returns
safeClose() now uses Promise.race with 1s timeout to prevent indefinite hang on dead socket
connect() now awaits safeClose() before opening new client — was fire-and-forget before
ECONNREFUSED at night/startup (inverter sleeping) no longer increments consecutiveErrors
Inverter sleep at dawn treated as expected state, not a recoverable fault

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: Registered as authoritative solar:read source (priority 15) over AlphaESS
AC-coupled topology confirmed: SolarEdge feeds AlphaESS EPS port, not DC-coupled
solar_power from SolarEdge AC output used as the canonical solar value

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: Added solar:curtail capability — stops SolarEdge export during negative price slots
Added grid:read capability at priority 6 (fallback behind HomeWizard P1)

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: Fixed solar forecast timezone bug: slot_datetime keys aligned to local time (CET/CEST)
Timestamps written in local time to match all other collectors

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: Initial release — SolarEdge HD-Wave SE3000H Modbus TCP integration
SunSpec-compliant register map (base address 40000)
AC power, DC power, lifetime energy, cabinet temperature reads
Collector interval 20 seconds
